read.cue: a defender is sitting in the passing lane to the open-looking middle ice

interaction.prompt: Your teammate has the puck, but two defenders are nearby. Drag YOURSELF to the open ice where they can actually pass to you.

feedback.right: Good read. The middle was covered by the second defender, so you found the open ice on the far side — a clean passing lane your teammate can use.
feedback.wrong: That spot is covered by a defender, so the pass can't get through. Look for the open ice that has no defender between you and the puck.

tip: Don't just skate to open space — make sure there's no defender in the passing lane between you and the puck.
why: Real support means an open passing LANE, not just open ice. A defender in the middle takes that option away, so the open spot is the one with a clear line to the puck.
